body_markdown:
NAPLES, Fla. — Oct. 22, 2026 —


Beasley Media Group is proud to congratulate Ryan Dietrich and Daniel Mann on being named winners of the prestigious Radio Wayne Awards, presented by Radio Ink, recognizing their outstanding contributions to the radio broadcasting industry.


The awards celebrate excellence, innovation and leadership among professionals who help drive the continued success of the radio industry.


This year’s Beasley Media Group winners include:


-


**Digital Sales Representative:** Ryan Dietrich, Beasley Media Group, Philadelphia, Pennsylvania


-


**Digital Sales Manager:** Daniel Mann, Beasley Media Group, New Jersey


These honors reflect Ryan and Daniel’s commitment to excellence, their dedication to delivering innovative solutions for advertisers and their continued contributions to Beasley Media Group’s success.
